exercise.name: Dumbbell Leg Curl
library_steps: Lie on your front along a bench, knees just past the end.
Grip a light dumbbell firmly between your feet.
Curl your heels towards your hips, then lower slowly.
exercise.one_line_summary: Face down along a flat bench, knees just past its end, a light dumbbell squeezed between the feet: legs near straight (start), knees curled to about 90 deg with shins vertical (end), hips pressed into the pad.

setup.target: Face down, thighs on the pad, knee joints just past the end so the knees can bend.
setup.tolerance: knee joint 0.03-0.08 m past the end

setup.target: One light dumbbell squeezed between the feet (feet together, ankles flexed), top plate on the soles. Drawn with the feet-held prop (props.feet, 12 Nov 2026).

movement.end: about 90-95 deg (shin vertical; more than 90 lets the dumbbell slip)
neutral, toes away from the hips

movement.measure: stays flat on the pad, about 0 deg (neutral, as in S1)

muscles.role: Flex the knee. Biceps femoris long head relatively more at low knee angles, semitendinosus more at larger angles (S2 intro; S1 regional shift between 30 and 90 deg).
Two-joint knee flexor that helps the curl (library lists no secondary; anatomical synergist).
Only ~20-30% of its hip-extension level during leg curls (S1); keeps the hips down.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Bottom rises as the heels come up.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Shortens the hamstrings at the hip and cheats the range.
The dumbbell can slip out from between the feet.

sources.citation: Hirose N, Kagaya Y, Tsuruike M. 2021. The task dependent differences in electromyography activity of hamstring muscles during leg curls and hip extensions. PLoS One 16(2):e0245838.
sources.what_it_gave: Prone isometric leg curls at 30 and 90 deg knee, hip neutral; BFlh/ST ratio and proximal-distal pattern change with knee angle; glut max 20-30% of hip-extension level.

sources.citation: Soga T, Nishiumi D, Furusho A, Akiyama K, Hirose N. 2021. Effect of different slopes of the lower leg during the Nordic hamstring exercise on hamstring electromyography activity. J Sports Sci Med 20:216-221.
sources.what_it_gave: Prone leg curl at 45 deg used for MVIC; BFlh favoured at lower knee flexion, ST at larger angles (cited background).
Lie on the front, knees past the end, dumbbell between the feet, curl heels toward hips, lower slowly.

clip_check.check: Thighs and chest on the pad, hips not lifted
Knee joint just past the bench end
Dumbbell between the feet shown, or the picture labelled 'dumbbell not shown'
clip_check.target: dumbbell drawn between the feet, handle along the shins, top plate on the soles, no plate inside a foot or shin

clip_check.check: Hamstrings the strongest red in both pictures
